paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak bar Ammi, Rav Ḥisda's student. In Ta'anit (16a): Who is 'accustomed'? One who has dependents and has nothing, has toil in the field, has an unblemished youth, and is acceptable to the people; they set their eyes on R. Yitzḥak bar Ammi. He visited Rav Ḥisda's house, chapter Mefannin (128b as printed; compare 128a). He said, ‘Rav Ḥisda said,’ Mo'ed Katan (10b). He was at Rav Ḥisda's burial (there, 25a).
